rule_name: Key fields present
description: Reporting date, lender group, format, category, row and column position, row label and observation type are all non-blank.
on_failure: Stop. A row without its keys cannot be placed in the model.

rule_name: Exactly one value column populated
description: Each row holds its value in either Observation or Number of Accounts. Neither or both is a failure.
on_failure: Clean rule C4 keeps the expected column and ignores the stray one. Rows are flagged corrected.

rule_name: Value present after cleaning
description: Every clean row that is not quarantined has a numeric value.
on_failure: Stop. The parsing rules missed a case.

rule_name: Value cells are numeric text
description: Every populated value cell is digits with optional thousands commas and padding spaces and nothing else.
on_failure: Stop. A new text pattern needs a cleaning rule.

rule_name: Reporting date parses
description: Reporting date is a real date in dd/mm/yyyy format.
on_failure: Stop. Row would be quarantined.

rule_name: Reporting date is a calendar quarter end
description: The return is quarterly, so the reporting date should be 31 March, 30 June, 30 September or 31 December.
on_failure: Clean rule C5 maps working-day dates and two repaired malformed dates to the quarter end.

rule_name: Known category values
description: Lender group is Banks or Non-Banks, format is PDH or BTL, observation type is one of the seven known types.
on_failure: Stop. A new value needs a dimension decision before loading.

rule_name: No duplicate raw rows
description: No two raw rows are identical in every source column.
on_failure: Stop. Investigate a double load or a duplicated extract.

rule_name: Grain is unique in clean
description: No two non-quarantined clean rows share quarter, lender group, portfolio, category, row position and column position.
on_failure: Stop. Clean rule C6 should have quarantined the extra row.

rule_name: Grain is unique in the fact table
description: No two fact rows share the same four dimension keys. The primary key also enforces this.
on_failure: Stop.

rule_name: Values are not negative
description: Counts and euro amounts cannot be below zero.
on_failure: Stop. The fact table also rejects negative values with a check constraint.

rule_name: Arrears amount does not exceed balance
description: For every line item, the arrears amount is at most the outstanding balance of the same accounts.
on_failure: Stop.

rule_name: Arrears total does not exceed total outstanding
description: Accounts in arrears cannot exceed accounts outstanding, and the balance of accounts in arrears cannot exceed total balance, for the same quarter and segment.
on_failure: Stop.

rule_name: Arrears total equals sum of buckets (accounts)
description: The count of accounts in arrears equals the sum of the arrears buckets. Counts must match exactly.
on_failure: Stop. Double counting or a missing bucket.

rule_name: Arrears total equals sum of buckets (euro amounts)
description: Euro amounts are published rounded to thousands, so each figure can be out by 0.5. The allowed gap is (number of buckets + 1) / 2 thousand euro.
on_failure: Stop.

rule_name: Legal status counts equal accounts in arrears
description: The four legal status categories should add up to the total accounts in arrears.
on_failure: Source inconsistency. Values are kept as published and the quarter is logged in the tracker.

rule_name: Every clean measure exists in dim_measure
description: The combination of category, row position and column position in clean maps to a dim_measure row.
on_failure: Stop. dim_measure is missing a measure.

rule_name: Every clean quarter exists in dim_date
description: Each mapped quarter end exists in the date dimension.
on_failure: Stop. dim_date does not cover the data range.

rule_name: Every fact row joins to all four dimensions
description: No fact row is orphaned from dim_date, dim_lender_group, dim_portfolio or dim_measure. Foreign keys also enforce this.
on_failure: Stop.

rule_name: Every fact row traces to a raw row
description: source_raw_row_id exists in the raw table, so every number can be traced to the source file.
on_failure: Stop. Lineage is broken.

rule_name: Core measures present for every segment and quarter
description: Each lender group, portfolio and quarter in the fact table has the five core measures: arrears total (accounts, balance, arrears amount) and total outstanding (accounts, balance).
on_failure: Not imputed. KPIs that need a missing measure show blank for that segment and quarter. Logged in the tracker.

rule_name: Every calendar quarter has data
description: Every quarter in dim_date between the first and last reporting quarter has fact rows.
on_failure: Investigate a missing return or a date mapping problem.

rule_name: Possessions at start equal prior quarter end
description: Residential properties in possession at the beginning of a quarter should equal the end of the previous quarter. Observation only.
on_failure: No action. Recorded because the published figures do not always reconcile, possibly due to restatements.
